Scope = the COMMON case + Tron's live-bridge/trace-pin surface (fully covered by state-independent HTTP refetch). The /app frozen-OPEN zombie residual is a SEPARATE deferred backlog item (1c842f26f) — NOT this task. Reuse the existing transport clients, NO fork.
